common: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE original painted fantasy JRPG skill icon, no sheet. Reference 1 is the EXACT style target: polished hand-painted item illustration, substantial dark warm contour edges, rich controlled saturation, crisp bevels, brush-painted material shading, top-left light, gold metal trim, readable solid silhouette. References 2 and 3 are character weapon and palette references only, no character portrait. Isolated on genuine transparent background. Square composition, all visible motif and glow contained within a centred circle of diameter 76% of canvas, generous completely transparent empty edges. Bold simple forms readable at 40px. No text, numbers, lettering, UI, button border, frame, rarity background, watermark, scenery, or extraneous props. Rune shapes are abstract geometry only.
